title: Hollis Equestrian Park
gap: No details on specific offerings or rentals
blurb: Hollis Equestrian Park is a widely-used horse park in southern Maine. It hosts various shows, club events, and trail rides from May until October. Members may use the park on non-event days for schooling their horses.
extraNote: Sponsorship signs must be ordered by April 1 to be displayed before the first event · Future sponsorship years cost $100 using the same sign · May until October
